normal.name: Ravanon
normal.text: Another October art challenge complete. A month of drawings of characters from anime, comics and videogames, using the #Arttrober2026 list published by Stanley Lau. It was fun, but also exhausting—and it killed almost all my free time for a month. But there was still one thing to do: compile all 31 drawings into a single image—so that's what I've gone and done. Any favourites? #Arttrober #Drawtober #Inktober #MastoArt #FediArt #FanArt #Manga #Anime #Comics #Gaming #Cartoon

normal.text: Hot take: the best part of old multiplayer games was dying first. You got to spectate and narrate everyone else's mistakes. Lightcycle games are perfect for it, since every crash is visible from the overhead view. Which game was most fun to watch after you'd lost? #gaming #retrogaming

normal.name: repeatro
normal.text: Due to the the overwhelming critics and me being a fan of such games, I started into the recently released puzzle game Order of the Sinking Star, made by the developers of The Witness. 🏝️ It plays like a crossover of Sokoban and the Trine titles. It shall offer more than 1,000 riddles and therefore more than 100 hours of entertainment. I'm two hours into the game now and there is already this "one more riddle"-feeling kicking in. 🤔 Btw, it runs flawlessly on #Linux. #gaming #Proton
